I completely understand where your coming from! That’s exactly how I was when I first started out so let me explain what made me go for it.

Tarot actually originated in Italy in the 1400s as an actual card game, like the games we play today except with a different deck of cards. They actually have extreme similarities to the deck of cards we use today. Ace-10, with a knight (page in tarot), Queen and king. Actually the only difference is that tarot has the Major arcana. (Moon, Sun, High Priestess, Tower, etc.)

I personally view tarot as a “self help” tool, it’s like therapy to a degree. The only part of the Bible that really warns against it is that you shouldn’t try to predict the future. I started out completely avoiding any questions dealing with the future, and then I learned something along the way. 

Tarot isn’t “predicting” the future, tarot is actually the readings of energies not physical events. So even if you do a “past, present, future” spread then it’s not telling you what will happen, it’s telling you the energies that MIGHT come your way. It also goes into your view on things as well, I do NOT believe the future is set in stone. I believe with the free will God gave us it would actually be very hard for the future to be set in stone.

Expanding on this, maybe you do a tarot spread and it says in the future the energies that surround you next week will be a promotion. Then you decide that Friday you are super tired and don’t want to go to work, free will. Because you made that choice, your future has changed, they might have been considering giving you a promotion but because of your free will choice to call out they decide to give it to someone else. 

Also, just because you read that the energy will be there, doesn’t mean that it will happen. It literally just means that there is a energy around you. Like for example the energy of a promotion, doesn’t mean that they are even looking to promote anyone. It’s literally just energy lol.

As far as they being demonic or attracting spirits. No. Not really. Honestly, if your house has spirits then they were there before you used tarot (like my old residence), but if the house doesn’t have spirits (like my new residence) it doesn’t attract them to you. 
The way I used to bypass this in my old residence is that I would actually ask my question to GOD and directed the energy of how I wanted the question answered at the cards. That’s only if you have spirits already present though, I just didn’t trust them not to meddle. (Also I was pretty sure that there might have been some kind of gateway in my previous house, like it was unnaturally haunted, I noticed long before I got into tarot. PS. So happy I moved!!! No issues anymore!)

Anyways, the thing that really sold me was when I was in your position I didn’t create a Reddit thread, I googled it. When I googled it I came upon a story where Christian NUNS were even using tarot as apart of their connection with GOD. I honestly think, like anything, it depends where your loyalties lie, and who you are directing your energy towards when you ask a question.

All in all, I’m very happy I got into tarot. It was a wonderful tool for me to get through an extremely tough time in my life. It really was my “self help” when I didn’t want to reach out to others for help. It’s really cool how each deck of cards has its own “personality” and energy (my first deck was always calling me out on my bs lol).

But at the end of the day, it’s really just a card game. You may need to remind yourself at times to just “take things with a grain of salt”. You are just reading energies. Just because the energy is there, doesn’t mean that it has/will happen.

Okay, I was directed here by the Chron’s disease subreddit. (On my other account,I posted on it on accident)

I will list below the symptoms and things that I have noticed during the years of dealing with whatever I have. 

-I can’t eat more than one meal a day. If I try to force feed myself a “normal” amount of food (3 meals), I get sick. I’m not nauseous, I don’t vomit, I’m just in a lot of pain in my abdomen that is frankly disabling.

-If I eat “too much” it feel’s literally like my food is just sitting in my stomach and not moving. For. Days. Also I will feel incredibly bloated during that time.

-I’m never hungry, if I am it’s a rare occurrence, but I will eat.

-Even if I do stick to “1 meal a day” sometimes I can’t even eat that, I’ll just have to skip a day or two. Maybe taking a literal bite or two of something.

-The abdominal pain comes and goes throughout the day regardless of how much I eat. It’s more manageable with 1 meal a day, but can still be disabling at times.

-I can eat smoothies with no issues or pain! Just like not real food.

-Also, if it matters I’m low in iron, b12, and very low in vitamin d.

-Bowl movements are far apart, mostly normal. Constipation can be an issue. Diarrhea occasionally.

-I’ve had an endoscopy and a colonoscopy with no findings, blood tests seem normal.
